objectives: Distinguish the sons of God from the daughters of men.
Identify the giants and the angels which kept not their first estate.
Explain the faith Noah showed in building the ark.
takeaways: The law against marrying into the other nations began in Genesis; Moses reiterated it (Deuteronomy 7:3).
The Most High shortened man's lifespan to 120 years (Genesis 6:3).
The angels that left their first estate were sons of God from Adam's line who mixed with the other nations (Jude 1:6).
Noah built the ark for rain that had never been seen; faith is the evidence of things not seen (Hebrews 11:1, 7).
As in the days of Noah, so shall the coming of the Son of man be: prepare your household and put on the spirit of Noah.
